translationRepairs: Chongyi also cited the Winter Office, Jade Workers: "The perforation of the bi is three cun," and the Erya: "When the rim is twice the perforation it is called a bi"; the rim on each side is three cun, and the perforation altogether nine cun—thus the nine-cun bi is clear.

Chongyi also cited the Winter Office, Jade Workers: "The perforation of the bi is three cun," and the Erya: "When the rim is twice the perforation it is called a bi"; the rim on each side is three cun, which together with the perforation makes nine cun in all—thus the nine-cun bi is clear.

兩邊肉各三寸，通好共九寸 means each rim is three cun and, together with the perforation (好), totals nine cun. The before wrongly makes the perforation alone nine cun; the after restores the rim-plus-hole arithmetic.

Your subjects observe that Jingzong in life was once emperor; offerings continue the ancestral line—having been called Jingzong, he should enter the ancestral temple; if he does not enter the ancestral temple, it is difficult to speak of 'zong.

The focus unit ends 難以言宗。; the literal opens a quote on 'zong but never closes it. Adding the closing mark after zong fixes a real punctuation defect without changing sense.

Chinese closes the Rites citation with 」 after 舍故而諱新; the literal opens a double quote for that citation and never closes it. The after supplies the missing outer closing quote.
